acceptance_walk:
Bench "review-l4-selftasks-chat" (daemon 49110, UI 2710, --provider bench) started from my worktree at fix/l4-selftasks-chat d9ee810, walked like a person with Playwright. Scripts are in /tmp/frbench/review-l4-selftasks-chat/scripts/. Each walk*.json holds the screen text of every step. The first bench's PNGs were wiped when I restarted the bench --fresh, but I looked at the key ones before that. Remaining PNGs: /tmp/frbench/review-l4-selftasks-chat/steps/01..05-m*.png.

1. L4-selftasks-116 (walk1.json a1..a5, project "Bakery" at Assisted). I typed `tool: task_update {...priority high} then say: Changing ... needs your yes. Press Yes ...`.
   - The model's restating sentence was dropped (126). The card showed once with Yes/No; I pressed Yes.
   - GET /changes: byAgent false, humanName "me", wordsUsed = my line. GET /inbox: no Update; the Inbox page shows "No updates".
   - Task reason is "Changed by you: priority to High" (API only). The drawer (a4) shows no reason line at all: it shows only the agent's reasons (task-words.ts AGENT_CHANGE).
2. L4-selftasks-117 (walk1/2/4/6/9).
   - Four chat read-backs were left 12-13 min (expiresAt null on GET /commands/pending), then the daemon was restarted (restart-daemon.mjs): pause with a model note, priority Low, a fix set, a drop fix set.
   - After the restart all four were still in Chat with Yes/No and in Inbox "Needs you (4)" (walk4 i1).
   - Yes applied the pause ("... The note goes into its next brief."), the fix set and the drop.
   - Garden: I changed the named task's priority on the Tasks tab, then Yes → '"Publish the page" changed since I asked: its priority is high now. Nothing was changed; ask again if you still want it.' (walk4 b1).
   - Quarry: fix set, then I paused another task in the drawer, then Yes → 'The tasks changed since I checked them; say "fix the tasks" to check again.' (walk6 q3).
   - Settings-screen card (POST /commands/execute budget.set, source ui): at 10 min it left the open Inbox without a reload and one Update appeared (walk9 samples at 11:58:39).
   - Vineyard: card answered in the Inbox in a second tab; the open Chat dropped Yes/No without a reload and read "(you said yes)" (walk5b).
3. L4-selftasks-105 (b) (walk2 e1/e2): two identical task_update calls gave one card of 2. Yes → "None of the 2 changes was made: one could not be made (nothing to change on "Write the FAQ"). Ask again if you still want them."; no chat change row.
4. L4-selftasks-126 (walk5b): a mixed `then say:` line kept "Two tasks are ready and none has run yet." and dropped the restating sentence.
5. L4-other-1 (walk3/3b).
   - New task, reviewer: "The reviewer writes no file: its findings are its report, which you read in the task's drawer." Coder: no line. Reviewer again with outcome 'review.md lists ...': Add task added it with specialist reviewer.
   - Drawer Edit: the line shows for reviewer, goes for coder, comes back for reviewer.
   - Start: the model-call log shows the reviewer's brief criterion "1. The report shows this outcome (this specialist writes no file, so a file named here is met by its report): review.md lists ..." and the same in the critic's request, never "not only the report".
   - On the stand-in, the critic sent the reviewer back twice ("the worker reports it could not do the work"). The ladder then gave the task to the data-analyst, which wrote review.md. U-098 step 4 cannot be shown on the stand-in.
6. Sibling probe across a restart (walk10/11, steps 04-m4, 05-m5): a chat pause read-back waited; I cancelled its task (Tasks route, confirmed); then restarted the daemon. The card was gone (GET /commands/pending []). Chat read "(not answered; ask again if you still want it)". The Inbox got: "... Forerunner restarted before you answered its card, and a card can only be answered while the app that showed it runs. Ask again in Chat if you still want it."
7. Header after a refused Yes (walk7/8): after the changed-since Yes, the open page kept "Waiting for you: 1 change to confirm [Answer]" and the Inbox badge for 40 s, while the daemon said nothing waits. A chat No does the same (walk8b), so this class existed before this branch.

Bench stopped with stop.mjs; its home and browser profile were deleted.

Tests I ran:
- chat-fix-tasks + security-command-actor: 40 passed.
- The area's UI and real-daemon cases: 7 passed.
- With the source diff reverted (git apply -R), 10 of the 11 new chat-fix-tasks cases fail on base. Two examples: the 116 restart case fails on author_human null; the 117 case fails on status 'expired'.
- The real-daemon 116 case fails on base (expiresAt set). The UI chat case fails with base store/context.tsx.
- pnpm test:injection: 84/84, record-011 and record-105 pass.
- pnpm test: 6107 passed / 7 skipped.
- UI vitest: 103 files, 1468 passed.
- biome lint of commands types.ts/executor.ts: clean.
- Playwright and test:integration/e2e: not run by me.

Worktree restored to d9ee810 and clean.

blocking.issue: A chat read-back that waits across a restart is dropped when the task it names moved in the meantime. The app then tells the person something that is now false. L4-selftasks-117 and the owner's 2026-11-17 answer say every chat read-back waits until it is answered, across a restart, and its Yes is decided on the state then.
blocking.where: packages/commands/src/executor.ts:754-815 (restorePending arms only isClosedProjectRefusal cards that fail to plan; any other prepareAll error leaves the card unarmed); packages/runtime/src/loop/answered-cards.ts:169-209 (expireOrphanedCards); packages/runtime/src/daemon/compose.ts:5999/6033 (commands.start() then expireOrphanedCards)
blocking.evidence: Bench walk10/11 (/tmp/frbench/review-l4-selftasks-chat/walk11.json; steps/04-m4-*.png, 05-m5-*.png). Chat pause read-back for "Write the FAQ"; the task was cancelled on the Tasks route; then restart-daemon. After it: GET /commands/pending []. Chat shows "(not answered; ask again if you still want it)". Inbox Update: "The change you asked for was not made: the task \"Write the FAQ\" (ready to paused). Forerunner restarted before you answered its card, and a card can only be answered while the app that showed it runs. Ask again in Chat if you still want it." The same happens to any waiting read-back whose task a session finished (task.pause plan's assertCan throws on done) before a restart.
blocking.expected: The card stays open in Chat and the Inbox after the restart, as it would without one. Its Yes then answers in one line what changed (changedSince, or the command's own refusal) and applies nothing. The orphan sweep never expires a chat or voice read-back, and never says a card can only be answered while the app runs. Add a test that composes the runtime twice on one home with this case (validation rule 4).

blocking.where: evals/src/injection-runner.ts (INJECTION_CHANNELS still web/email/record/report); evals/injection/cases (only record-011/record-105 added); docs/maintainers/testing.md new section says 'not built yet'

Acceptance: 'the brief and fix_tasks channels exist with cases and controls; report-008 (researcher reach) and the hand-over judge pass and fail without their guards'. The fixer's not_done lists the brief channel, report-008 and C3-left-10's judge as not done. pnpm test:injection shows 84 cases, none in a brief channel.

The hand-over judge: a record asking for a thorough answer, a stronger model or a higher amount. Each fails without its guard.

blocking.issue: The owner's 117 acceptance asks for a real-daemon case: a chat read-back left more than 10 minutes and across a daemon restart still waits, and its Yes applies. Validation rule 4 asks for compose twice on one home. Neither exists. The only restart cases rebuild the CommandLoop over an in-memory store, which skips compose's start order. That gap is how the first blocking bug got through.

non_blocking: A Yes that closes a card without a change, or a No, leaves the open page stale. After the new changed-since and tasks-changed refusals (and a plain No in chat), the header keeps 'Waiting for you: 1 change to confirm [Answer]' and the Inbox badge for 40+ s until a reload (walk8/8b). POST /chat's heardChat emits inbox.changed only for a new pending card and project events only for done actions (server.ts ~2797-2806). This was there before the branch, but this area adds two frequent new paths into it. Small fix: emit inbox and project when a turn answered a card.

'fix the tasks' read-back fingerprint: taskListFingerprint includes every task's status. A fix read-back answered while a session runs (statuses moving) will almost always get 'The tasks changed since I checked them'. That is the literal reading of decision 53; the session lead may want session-driven status moves excluded.

The decision's default 'a change that acts at once on the person's words is theirs too' is not built. The model's acts-at-once calls stay the agent's on Changes, though they are no Inbox echo. The fixer's reason is real: security-command-actor.test.ts pins author_agent for a model note_add. The session lead should decide.

Words. The 120 read-back ends with a double period ('Note for its next brief: "Put on hold by the person.".'). lapsedCardUpdate says 'The change you asked for was not made: the session budget for Quarry.' without the values, while the orphan sibling says '(CHF 5.00 to CHF 20.00)'. Inbox Updates of type warning show a 'warning' badge; that rendering was there before.

Stand-in gap: the bench critic sends a reviewer that changed no file back ('the worker reports it could not do the work'). After two tries the ladder gives the task to the data-analyst, which writes review.md and replaces the person's chosen reviewer in the drawer. U-098 step 4 can only be checked on the real model (F-11). Teach the stand-in critic the report-form criterion.

ADR 0109's amendment says decision 1 covers 'New task, Edit, chat', but chat's read-back clause (D-6) was not built. Edit still calls useWhoChoices(true) with no project or words (D-3's 'Edit asks with its project and the edited words'). The line still shows, because it does not depend on them.

store/context.tsx reloads every conversation that shows a waiting card on every inbox.changed, including the polling mode's periodic counts. Chat cards now wait indefinitely, so this costs extra GET /conversation calls while they wait.

Still open, as the fixer's not_done says: L4-selftasks-120's redirect guards still judge by the note's presence (task.ts:1303-1308, 1506-1508); a changedSince case for a settings or budget card is untested; L4b-left-1..5; L4-other-1 D-5 and D-6; 125's bench README and docs:check parts; no bench before/after walk or screenshots from the fixer.

Writes nothing about the waiting card: CHAT_PENDING_NOTE ('The app shows this question under your reply with Yes and No. ...') reaches the model. The stand-in echoes that sentence back into the reply, which the backstop does not drop. With the real model, check in LC-C13/C16 that it is never repeated.
